recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration adopt the draft force generation manual without further delay and issue guidelines which cover the entire process of force generation. The Administration should designate an accountable and responsible process owner, define the roles of individual staff, establish mechanisms such as regular staff rotation to address any conflict of interest and regulate the competitive selection of contributing countries.
